pretreatments.description: Granular sludge collection from a full-scale UASB digester
Heat shock: Boiling granular sludge at 90 °C for 30 min
Aeration: Aerating granular sludge for 24 h with an air flow rate of 3 L/min
Alkaline pre-treatment: Adjusting the pH of granular sludge to 12.0 ± 0.1 with 3 N NaOH and maintaining for 24 h
Pre-treatment with WFO: Adding a saponified WFO solution (15 g/L) to granular sludge cultures (33 gVS sludge/L saponified WFO solution) and maintaining for 24 h
pH adjustment to 5.5 using NaOH (3 M) and HCl (3 M)
Addition of 5 gVS/L of untreated granular sludge to the reactors for the second stage
